args.title: Juniper Labware Newsletter Summary – Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter: "Freight pricing this quarter" from Juniper Labware highlights the linked article on current freight market trends.
- Linked article: Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel price changes.
- Companion piece (subscriber content, accessed via team code SUB-7378): Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least overall.
